changes.evidence: Beck worked at Stark Industries until Tony fired him in 2016 (the MIT B.A.R.F. lecture, before Far From Home); in Far From Home he is only recalled as an ex-employee who rallied other fired Stark staff into his crew. Stark Industries is backstory.

Ammit was betrayed by the Ennead and bound in an ushabti about 2,000 years before Moon Knight; she is never on the Ennead during the show (the wiki lists Ennead Council as former). With the backstory stage removed, the 'Independent' departure stage has no group to leave from, so no stages remain (left should drop 'Moon Knight' too).

Eyes of Wakanda ep 1 'Into the Lion's Den': Nkati was a Royal Guard captain and War Dog (Hatut Zaraze) who had already deserted Wakanda with stolen vibranium before the episode; he says so to Noni. In the episode he only rules his own pirate kingdom (Lion's Kingdom, not a group in this record). War Dogs is backstory, so the 'Independent' departure stage goes with it (left should drop 'Eyes of Wakanda'). If the owner wants his own kingdom as a group: [["Lion's Kingdom", "(from the start)"]].

After freeing Widows, Yelena goes to work for Valentina on target operations; in the Black Widow post-credits scene she is on 'holiday leave' from Valentina and asks for a raise, takes the Clint Barton job (Hawkeye), and 'continued to work for' Valentina until Thunderbolts*, where that work is O.X.E. The join happens in the post-credits scene, not Thunderbolts*. (The organization isn't named O.X.E. until Thunderbolts*.)
